You can now do all of the following, using a carefully crafted URL to lite.datasette.io: Load client-side Datasette to browse any SQLite database, JSON file, CSV file or SQL script Select a released version of Datasette to load from PyPI Load a specific commit, tag, or branch name from the Datasette GitHub repository Pick from over 100 versions of SQLite to use with Datasette Install additional Datasette plugins from PyPI or URLs to wheel files, including JavaScript visualization tools The ability to load specific Datasette references, plugins, and SQLite versions makes this a fantastic tool for linking to demos of work-in-progress features or bug reproductions, without needing to spin up a full web server to serve that demo. items.summary: libp2p gossipsub creates unbounded subscription entries in its default config, which can cause denial of service via memory exhaustion. Upgrade @libp2p/gossipsub to 17.0.0 or later.

items.summary: A vulnerability in js-libp2p's ASN.1 DER decoder allows remote attackers to stall the Node event loop using crafted public keys before authentication. Upgrade @libp2p/crypto to 5.1.22 or later.
